title: Expose authenticated owner inquiry completion
requirements: Extend only POST /api/v1/admin/inquiries/{inquiry_id}/commands to accept the reviewed COMPLETE envelope {type:'COMPLETE',expected_version,expected_visit_versions,payload:{}} and delegate only to OwnerCommandService.complete_inquiry. Preserve CONFIRM and START_NEGOTIATION behavior and do not alter core validation.

Reuse valid owner session, exact Origin, JSON, CSRF, Idempotency-Key and no-store boundary. Malformed inquiry UUID is 404. Strict envelope/type/payload failures reject before dispatch and do not consume the key.

First success is 200 {data:{command_id,inquiry,changed_visits}}; exact accepted replay is same data with Idempotent-Replay:true. Map NOT_FOUND 404; IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH, VERSION_CONFLICT and PARTICIPATION_CONFLICT 409; RESULT_EXPIRED 410; EXPECTED_VERSION_REQUIRED, INVALID_TRANSITION and VALIDATION_ERROR 422. Preserve existing mappings for CONFIRM and START_NEGOTIATION.

Add isolated synthetic PostgreSQL route tests for browser boundary, strict COMPLETE and compatibility of other types, successful completion without cash prerequisite, receipt/audit, participation closure and planned visit, invalid state/visit/version maps with no mutation and reusable key, stable replay/mismatch/expiry. Never read local .env or configured source database.
Do not add group completion, cancellation, correction, payments, checkout, webhooks, notifications, migrations, frontend, bots, secrets or external calls.
acceptance: A signed-in owner can mark one confirmed inquiry completed through the command endpoint without ending the group visit or requiring final payment.
Browser state, versions and idempotency protect completion without partial history.
Focused synthetic PostgreSQL tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted narrow HTTP adapter over reviewed completion core without group visit or payment mutation.
